sections.heading: Overview
bullets: Wing 5's capstone fight — built around protecting friendly Reaper allies (that carry the squad's real damage) while managing Dhuum's own kill mechanics. Two-stage enrage.

sections.heading: Greens (protecting the Reapers)
bullets: Every 30 seconds Dhuum reaches for a friendly Reaper, telegraphed by a large green circle — a player must stand in it or the Reaper dies.
Standing in it lifts you skyward, where you have 15 seconds to catch 5 red orbs to come back down safely.
This rotates across 3 players (commonly called G1/G2/G3) — you cannot take two Greens in a row without dying, so know your rotation.

sections.heading: Death Mark & Shackles
bullets: Death Mark: Dhuum appears on a random player with a large orange circle — anyone caught has their boons stolen and must sprint back to their pillar of light within 10 seconds or die.

Shackles (from 60%): the two non-tank players closest to Dhuum get tethered together (yellow border, red tether) — 4 seconds later the shackle activates and deals heavy damage unless you've already run in opposite directions to separate.

sections.heading: Messengers
bullets: These adds fixate on whoever attacks them first and die on their own 15 seconds after fixating — a dedicated kiter should grab one and run it around the arena so it doesn't chew through the friendly Reapers instead.

sections.heading: Greater Death Mark (soul split, ~6:30)
bullets: Dhuum pulls everyone out of their body for 20% max HP damage plus torment stacks — sprint back to your own glowing soul marker before the timer runs out or it's a death.
Face the center of the room when Dhuum reappears and keep your back to a safe wall so you're not caught out of position.

sections.heading: Enrage
bullets: 10:00 soft enrage from 100%→10% (Dhuum's damage jumps +500%), then a hard 1:45 window from 10%→0% that wipes the squad outright if missed.
